posts.title: grimshire
posts.description: the idea of loss, and death is something that i struggle with. because i know i struggle with it, i tend to welcom eit with open arms. lately i guess i've been thinking in terms of "what if i lost all of that which i'm used to" that's a hard topic ... i don't think anyone has an ansewer to that. it's not like we ever really go into situations like that willingly, sometimes we do unwillingly though
